description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2213/35 dated 03rd February 2021, issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance amending the Foreign Exchange (Classes of Capital Transactions Undertaken in Sri Lanka by a Person Resident Outside Sri Lanka) Regulations. While it mentions the Minister's name and title, the primary content is regulatory in nature - specifically amending financial regulations under the Foreign Exchange Act. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for foreign exchange transactions.
